math.bom_domain_steps: one recorded total per part/unit/currency with full occurrence operands

case_evidence.reference_binding: frozen question references independent source inputs; hash, commit, snapshot, config, gate, eval, case, department and reviewer must match

observation_capture.source: actual canonical runtime results; never reconstruct observed operands from golden inputs
observation_capture.lifecycle: export only after successful event collection and stream close; cancellation, deadline and snapshot failures cannot export
observation_capture.transport: optional typed terminal field outside diagnostics; capture adds no REST, SSE, history or raw logging payload
observation_capture.approval: local unreviewed observation only; accepted=false; offline_only=true; no activation authority
observation_capture.remaining_gate_work: bind observations to versioned run/case/source snapshot and independent adjudication; preserve legacy run_eval v1 evidence

fixed_case_runner.scope: internal provider-free fixed-selection seam; no operator CLI or storage yet
fixed_case_runner.actor: strict active SQL profile with explicit ID and username must exactly match frozen roles, department/site permissions and clearance; reviewer privilege is required and never added
fixed_case_runner.consistency: actor, current department catalog and selected source evidence share one SERIALIZABLE SQL snapshot; collection, close, snapshot commit and post-commit cancellation/deadline checks must succeed
fixed_case_runner.acl_failure: query failure is not an unrestricted empty site set; unknown/inactive departments fail closed; missing or invalid clearance stays public
fixed_case_runner.bindings: declared source/snapshot/config/gate/eval plus run/case/dataset and case hash; binding_verification remains pending until runtime verification is implemented
fixed_case_runner.approval: adjudication_reference=null; no correctness/reviewer labels or acceptance generated
fixed_case_runner.remaining: operator authorization, protected evidence persistence, verified runtime bindings and independent adjudication; legacy run_eval remains unchanged

bound_review_join.bindings: hash-pinned case, observation, reviews and business identities; exact source/snapshot/config/gate/eval, run/case/department/dataset, actor and case/observation hashes
bound_review_join.reviewers: exactly two unique independent quality reviewers; one third adjudicator only when quality labels disagree; active non-synthetic matching business identity artifacts required
bound_review_join.risks: any leaked=true or wrong_version=true from any reviewer including adjudicator remains true; risk disagreement stays separate and positive quality labels cannot clear it
bound_review_join.metadata: typed frozen actor shared with runner; observed outcome must be a valid string enum; output contains labels and hashes, no answer or Math operands
bound_review_join.limits: identity artifacts are assertions, not operator authentication; binding_verification remains pending; accepted=false and offline_only=true
bound_review_join.remaining: protected persistence, runtime binding verification, reviewer authorization and readiness gate adapter; artifact join alone grants no acceptance

case_evidence.validation: recompute every step, source, outcome and rounding with evaluate_math_v2; count must equal actual branch steps; comparisons at most4 each, all BOM branches share500 totals, request at most508 with query and500 standalone
case_evidence.baseline_policy: baseline_source_commit and original per-arm limits stay independent of candidate; legacy Math request count remains at most1
case_evidence.other_branches: optional exact frozen branch_id/kind/status/source_ids records; only query requests, combined actions at most3, usable branch citations must occur in final case citations

query_branch_evidence.reference: independently frozen query_branch_schema and query_branches in the fixed-template Math reference; observations must match exact typed fields
query_branch_evidence.dependencies: unique earlier branch IDs; execute only when all dependencies have complete source data; partial Graph context with reviewed complete source data may satisfy a dependency
query_branch_evidence.skipped_math: executed=false, blocked/dependency_unavailable, no citations, no canonical Math result and zero contributed calculations
query_branch_evidence.storage_failure: executed=true, unknown/evidence_unavailable, incomplete source data, no citations or canonical Math result; exact failure must be independently frozen
query_branch_evidence.canonical_link: every other executed Math action has one canonical result and one reference input with matching branch_id and template, in branch order
query_branch_evidence.outcome: evaluate all branch statuses; Math partial data is incomplete; unknown/blocked data is incomplete; complete requires complete source data
query_branch_evidence.compatibility: legacy other_branches remains separate; do not mix it with this contract; absent branch fields or null schema plus empty list preserve standalone legacy references
query_branch_evidence.unsupported: per-branch intent overflow has no invented result and remains fail-closed; natural-language planning and versioned runner/adjudication integration remain pending

case_evidence.outcome_policy: full requires all complete; partial requires usable and incomplete branches; refusals have no usable branches; clarification has no executed actions

query.source_read_consistency: one SQL SERIALIZABLE read transaction across branches and standalone templates; nested actions reuse the outer transaction
query.sql_session_lock_wait: bounded by remaining request deadline and original session limit; restore before returning the connection
query.sql_transaction_failure: on SQL execution failure, continue independent branches only with XACT_STATE()=1; aborted, uncommittable or unverifiable transactions discard the whole response without retry
query.sql_staging_gate: required: concurrency 1/5, writer interaction and existing latency limits
query.domain_steps_basis: BOM totals use the shared 500-relation budget; each comparison records at most four steps, up to two comparisons alongside a BOM
query.dependency_basis: complete reviewed source data, separate from truncated answer context
query.implementation_scope: explicit caller-selected fixed templates; natural-language planning and text retrieval branches remain pending
query.extended_gate_status: requires frozen approved v2 gate; legacy limits are unchanged

notes: Example only. Bind immutable source/data/config/gate/evaluation and real reviewer before freezing; this file grants no pilot or activation authority.
